title: Package DevSpace MCP connectivity for deploy readiness
objective: Make ChatGPT-to-local DevSpace connectivity a documented, provider-agnostic, secret-safe deployment profile without exposing the Studio Web/API publicly by default.
acceptance_criteria: DevSpace tunnel is modeled as an optional ChatGPT+DevSpace deployment profile
DevSpace port 7676 and Studio port 8080 are separated by policy
ngrok and Cloudflare provider options are documented
example config contains no real credentials
connectivity doctor does not print owner secrets
persistent workspaceId reuse contract is documented
public MCP smoke test is recorded on a real development PC before acceptance
verification: verify ChatGPT opens one workspace and reuses the same workspaceId
verify bounded DevSpace read/write/test task succeeds
risks: A public tunnel increases attack surface
ChatGPT host capability can fail before requests reach DevSpace
notes: Source pack is on main. Task remains verify until local/public MCP acceptance is executed on the target PC.
